plugins.description: Attri for AI assistants: link attribution, site analytics, Search Console data joined to on-site behaviour, and the posture review (ranked findings on what to fix first). Connects to Attri's MCP server with OAuth; you choose the workspaces and permissions.

skills.name: attri-search-analyst
skills.description: Read Attri's ranked findings and Search Console data joined to on-site behaviour, explain what to fix first and why, and act on findings when asked. Use when a person asks what to improve on their site, why traffic or rankings changed, or which pages and queries deserve work.

skills.name: attri-weekly-review
skills.description: Run a weekly review of an Attri workspace — what moved in traffic and search, which findings are new or resolved, what to do next — and plan the chosen actions. Use on a schedule or when a person asks for a weekly summary.
